conn = sqlite3.connect("./world.db")
cur = conn.cursor()
cur.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'")
tables = [r[0] for r in cur.fetchall()]
print("TABLES:", tables)
for t in tables:
    cur.execute(f"PRAGMA table_info({t})")
    cols = [(r[1], r[2]) for r in cur.fetchall()]
    print(f"TABLE {t}: {cols}")
    zip_cols = [c[0] for c in cols if any(k in c[0].lower() for k in ["zip","postal","address"])]
    if zip_cols:
        print(f"  ZIP COLS: {zip_cols}")
        for zc in zip_cols:
            cur.execute(f"SELECT DISTINCT [{zc}] FROM [{t}] LIMIT 20")
            vals = [r[0] for r in cur.fetchall()]
            print(f"  {zc} values: {vals}")
